description: This file defines utilities for launching and managing child processes, including process cleanup, signal handling, and process lifecycle management within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: gracefullyCloseAll
methods.description: Closes all processes registered for graceful closure.

methods.name: gracefullyProcessExitDoNotHang
methods.description: Ensures process exits after attempting graceful shutdown, with a timeout fallback.

methods.name: launchProcess
methods.description: Launches a child process with specified options, manages its lifecycle, and provides methods for graceful shutdown and killing.

methods.name: envArrayToObject
methods.description: Converts an array of environment variable objects to a key-value object.
